meta.dataset: SBA PPP loans matching the Punctual Pros (residential HVAC, plumbing, electrical) screen (ZIP not resolved to a location)
meta.match_rule: NAICS 238210, 238220; PA, NJ, DE, MD, NY borrowers (PPP: ProjectState when BorrowerState is miscoded) within 120 miles (straight line, ZIP centroid) of Lancaster PA 17601 or Toms River NJ 08753. These rows matched the NAICS codes and state but their ZIP has no Census centroid, so distance could not be measured.
meta.columns_note: Every column and cell exactly as the SBA released it, as strings, in the SBA file order. An empty string is an empty cell. A byte the SBA file holds that is not valid UTF-8 (0xBF, in a few lender and business-type names) is shown as ¿. Nothing is filtered: sole proprietors, self-employed individuals and independent contractors are included, and so are the PPP Race, Ethnicity, Gender and Veteran fields.
meta.data_age: PPP loans approved Apr 2020 - May 2021; JobsReported is what the borrower reported on the application then. Batch dated 2024-09-30 (latest on the portal when run).

rows: Existing or more than 2 years old
